title: How the run ended, and whether telemetry kept up
description: The terminal event each process published: status, reason, and how many records the exporter queued or lost. A nonzero lost count means every number on this dashboard is computed from a short row set — max and p95 understate first.

defaults.noValue: No terminal event. The run is still going, or it died without one — check the job, not this panel.

params.value: SELECT json_get(attributes_json, 'role') AS role, json_get(body_json, 'status') AS status, json_get(body_json, 'reason') AS reason, MAX(CAST(json_get(body_json, 'export_lost_records') AS BIGINT)) AS lost_records, MAX(CAST(json_get(body_json, 'export_queued_records') AS BIGINT)) AS queued_records FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'terminal' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2
